author: Hayley Quinn
title: Looking for semi-realistic artist for two characters from Defy The Dusk
content:
NO DMS.

Strict budget up to $300 & looking for someone to accept half payment before starting 💕

Looking for an artist in a semi realistic/realistic art style to draw two characters in a fantasy setting from Danielle L. Jensen’s new duology Defy The Dusk. The focus will be on the two characters in a dancing scene, and background will be minimal.

This will be for personal use & there is no deadline. Please share your portfolio so I can get a sense of your style. Thank you!

author: sega_jenesis_
title: Commissioning artist for custom Pokémon card binder scenes
content:
🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀

I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them!

I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters.

Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway!

Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚

If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. 🥰

author: Aura Frost
title: ISO digital artists for 3 full body dark characters under $75 each
content:
I’m braving it…

ISO digital artists/recs:
- who can do under $75 per character, I will need 3 characters (full body) 
- comfortable drawing dark characters (scars, maybe blood)
- good with facial expressions!

Comment below with some examples and your pricing if you can pretty please! Bonus points if you’re queer and/or BIPOC. Or recommend an artist if you know of one who might fit! 

IMPORTANT:
GenAI will get you blocked.
Unsolicited DMs will get you blocked.

author: not_ordr
title: Looking for character art artist for upcoming book, flexible payment
